prompt.description: Verbatim text to speak. In multi-speaker mode, each turn is a separate 'Speaker: utterance' line matching speaker_mapping; optional turn_styles follows that order.

output_file_path.description: Required local output path; use .wav for Gemini. Existing workspace/absolute path policy applies.

generation_config.description: Model-specific parameters for configured Gemini 3.8 TTS; configured default model/runtime remains authoritative.

mode.description: Single voice or existing up-to-two-prebuilt-speaker dialogue.

voice_name.description: Single-speaker prebuilt/Extended Google voice ID, forwarded unchanged. Featured choices (not exhaustive): Zephyr, Puck, Charon, Kore, Fenrir, Leda, Orus, Aoede, Callirrhoe, Autonoe, Enceladus, Iapetus, Umbriel, Algieba, Despina, Erinome, Algenib, Rasalgethi, Laomedeia, Achernar, Alnilam, Schedar, Gacrux, Pulcherrima, Achird, Zubenelgenubi, Vindemiatrix, Sadachbia, Sadaltager, Sulafat. Tested addition: ar-001-advisor-1 (Authoritative Advisor 1, ar-001; generation verified on Vertex Express, not Arabic quality). Other supplied IDs are not pre-verified; provider may reject them. No custom lifecycle promise.

style_instructions.description: Optional global delivery instructions, separate from transcript; fallback for turns without a nonempty override.

speaker_mapping.description: Required in multi-speaker mode: one or two unique speakers matching prompt labels. Existing featured prebuilt voices only.

speaker.description: Exact speaker label used before the first colon in dialogue lines.

voice.description: Featured prebuilt dialogue voice; this constraint is distinct from single-speaker voice_name.

turn_styles.description: Optional multi-speaker-only ordered style entries, exactly one per parsed dialogue line. Nonempty string overrides global style; null or empty/whitespace inherits it. Wrong count/type fails before generation. Omit array to use global style for all turns.
